# Bridge Trainer: Learn & Bid

> Bridge Trainer is a free bridge bidding practice app for iPhone and iPad. Learn contract bridge in five-minute drills on bidding, play and defense. No account.

## App

- [Bridge Bidding Practice App for iPhone | Bridge Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bridge/index.html.md): Bridge Trainer is a free bridge bidding practice app for iPhone and iPad. Learn contract bridge in five-minute drills on bidding, play and defense. No account.

## Guides

- [Best Bridge App for Beginners (2026): 5 Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bridge/best-bridge-app-for-beginners.html.md): The best bridge apps for beginners on iPhone and iPad compared in October 2026: lesson courses, bot games, online duplicate and drills, with honest trade-offs.
- [Bridge Bidding for Beginners | Bridge Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bridge/bridge-bidding-for-beginners.html.md): Bridge bidding for beginners: count high-card points, pick your opening bid, and respond to partner with worked hands for 1NT, one-of-a-suit and passes.
